correctness.rationale: For every even integer N>=6, the tangent K-theory identity TG=N S^* - End(S), the Chern roots of End(S), and the N-fold normal exact sequence give the displayed degree-d polynomial. Schur alternant integration is proved by the top rectangle class, so Gauss–Bonnet yields E_N without induction assumptions. Weak Lefschetz, Schubert partition counts and Poincare duality give all remaining rational Betti ranks; the primitive middle rank subtracts the ambient Schubert dimension. The exact independent localization and coefficient computations for N=6,8,10,12 agree, and no finite check is used as an infinite proof. In particular the N=10 polynomial c6 and e=24920, b6=24912, primitive b6=24910 are directly reproducible.
